fullContentHtml:
Armed Forces AFMS SSC Medical Officer Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Joined Armed Forces Medical Services (AFMS) has released the notification for the post of SSC Medical Officer (Short Service Commissioned). This recruitment has been issued for 400 posts. Online applying process for Armed Forces AFMS SSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2025 has started from 19 April 2025 & the candidates can apply till 12 May 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Armed Forces AFMS SSC Medical Officer Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 19 April 2025
  • Last Date : 12 May 2025
  • Interview Start On : 19 June 2025

Application Fee

  • General, EWS : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, SC : Rs. 200/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online

Armed Forces AFMS SSC Medical Officer Online Form 2025 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
